title: Measurement exports
content:
I understand that to get my required measurements points from CLO3D out of the system, the only way is by a tech pack? (Is it possible to get get them just as a table?) I understand that they are exported as an excel - if i do this for multiple versions of the same pattern - is it possible that this information can be exported to a google sheet or dropped as a new row on to a single Microsoft Excel Workbook file? 

Hope that makes sense?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: So, is there no way to do batch exports of POMs to CSV?
Reply 1: If several POMs exist in the same project, you can import them all in the same CSV file! Otherwise, you can try our APIs to batch export POMs https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/73400b05faa7449a80bfeb6213944108

Comment 2: A single workbook file is not possible. But you can get the measurements without creating a tech pack. POMs can be saved as CSV files from their tab in the Object Browser. CSV files can be opened in Excel.
Reply 1: awesome - can batches of POMs go on to the same csv?
Reply 2: All POMs that are loaded in the scene will go into the CSV.
content_description: This page explains how to export measurement points from CLO3D tech packs as Excel files and explores options for consolidating multiple versions into a single Google Sheet or Excel workbook.
